all_text_content:
Verse of the Day
Behold, are ye stripped of pride? I say unto you, if ye are not ye are not prepared to meet God. Behold ye must prepare quickly; for the kingdom of heaven is soon at hand, and such an one hath not eternal life.
Alma 5:28
Quote of the Day
"I witness that a spiritual power and direction … will come into our lives as we keep the law of obedience and sacrifice."
Elder Jorge T. Becerra | 1 Apr 2026General Conference
